buildOrder.why: Everything downstream scores and routes what enrichment produces. Bad input, bad machine.
Decides who gets a message this week. Timing over fit.
The first system that touches revenue. Minutes matter.
Feeds scoring with fresh timing instead of stale lists.
Tells you which segment × persona is actually working, so you can double down.
